regions.today: A cloudier day overall today with some bright spells.Scattered showers developing, mainly away from the coast,with the odd heavy one possible. Highest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in mainly light northeasterly or variable winds.
regions.tonight: Becoming dry with cloud giving way to clear spells tonight, although some cloud may linger in the south. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 8 degrees in light to moderate northerly winds, increasing fresh at times in parts of the south.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be mainly dry with sunny spellsbut with cloudier conditions and the chance of a shower in southern areas. Breezy with a moderate to fresh north to northeasterly wind and highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees.
